disqualifier.note: Independent admission facts over one LiveAdmissionState+ticket: legacy-origin lease, queued peer, combined owner, and same-checkout lease may each fire alone or together; isTicketSkippable ORs them as free skip conditions, not a masked union.

Independent validity axes over one AiMetricsRetentionSelector: any-bound presence, mutation-safe boundedness, and since<until ordering can fail separately; callers combine them as free preconditions, not exclusive phases.

ok is a success-envelope Literal(true) on the decoded report type; manifestWritten independently records whether the sidecar file was written. Both-true and ok-with-manifestWritten-false are legal operator outcomes.

Independent QualityTaskStep shape classifiers (direct bunx turbo run vs nested beep ci lane). A step is at most one kind, but the predicates are free boolean helpers over argv shape, not one shared phase register.
